steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与迭代提示；不要回退代码，而是向前修复。认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security is top priority; open source can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体应有趣且拟人；安全是首要；并坦言开源项目可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand matters more than products; open source runs everywhere, but compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何环境，但算力是瓶颈。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为规模是必要但不充分条件，多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出语言模型合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robotics adoption will be slower than ChatGPT; embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，预测机器人采用比 ChatGPT 慢，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as a single event but diffused through personal agents, already present in daily workflows.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非以单一事件到来，而是通过个人智能体弥散式地渗透进日常工作，已经在我们身边。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; clear English instructions become executable skills, turning anyone into a programmer.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；清晰的英文指令变成可执行的技能，让任何人都能成为程序员。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files and context library; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by someone else.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件和上下文库；否则你的工作就会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: AI agents multiply individual output 100x across all knowledge work, not just coding, reshaping business loops.
garrytan.zh: AI 智能体将个人产出提升百倍，覆盖所有知识工作，而不仅是编程，重塑商业闭环。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; agents replace mid-level management, not humans.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位计费的模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体取代中层管理，而非人类。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型处理 90%的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进模仿人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Companies must own specialized intelligence; sovereign models necessary; inference layer not commodity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，坚持公司必须拥有专用智能；主权模型必要；推理层不是商品。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering trade-offs in latency, throughput, cost.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门工程，并在延迟、吞吐量和成本之间权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demand will grow 10-100x, even with AI-assisted coding; human accountability remains essential for mission-critical systems.
philipkiely.zh: 即使有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程需求将增长 10-100 倍；在关键任务系统中，人的责任仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的，而量化是有损的；分离式预填充和解码正在兴起。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, requiring quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs shift focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，需要量化感知训练和蒸馏；未来 GPU 将重心转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often lose to modular kernels in production.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；在生产中，巨型内核往往不如模块化内核。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for becoming multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，是实现多星球文明的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate. AI safety hinges on truthfulness, not political correctness.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑，电极扩展可提升通信速率；AI 安全关键在于追求真理而非政治正确。

elon.en: We're at the early stage of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们正处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年出现，存在 10-20%的灭绝风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant; space-based AI compute is inevitable.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，丰饶和通缩将使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 算力成为必然。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准应持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 LLM 可从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，预测行为准确度可达人类的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational human behavior; simulations should represent human values and biases.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，反共识观点：为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性人类行为；模拟应体现人类价值观和偏见。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会，需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

joonpark.en: A single simulation session could cost $100 million in a few years, enabling testing of hypotheses impossible due to scale or cost.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，预测未来几年单次模拟成本可达 1 亿美元，从而能测试因规模或成本而无法进行的假设。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often needing longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长时间思考；思维链用人类语言逐步表达这一过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to make GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对让 GPT-4 连贯有用至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限。

tworek.en: Current models lack self-correction from failures, a key missing piece for AGI; continual learning is necessary.
tworek.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是 AGI 缺失的关键部分；持续学习是必需的。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非 Scaling 是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续推动机器学习进步，算法改进与规模效应相乘带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; untapped sources include video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data; pre-training should interleave action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人数据和合成数据尚待开发，预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测下一个词。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips can cut latency by 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他明确表示推理（inference）而非训练才是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x more than compute.
jeffdean.zh: 同期，他提出多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍，挑战了传统认知。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient training and inference at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿始终，Jeff Dean 强调专用硬件（如 TPU、低精度推理芯片）对大规模训练和推理效率至关重要。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; ML augments jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，机器学习将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key; hybrid human-AI creates value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练结合专家数据是关键，人机混合创造更大价值。

awang.en: Data remains bottleneck; synthetic data not a silver bullet; product design blocks agents; US-China no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调数据仍是瓶颈，合成数据非万能，产品设计是智能体最大障碍，中美研究无差距。

awang.en: AI centralizes power; data poisoning threat; recursive self-improvement era; agents finally work; trust and safety critical.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据投毒威胁大，进入递归自我改进时代，智能体终于可用，信任与安全至关重要。

awang.en: Superintelligence imminent; scaling across compute, data, RL; open-sourcing unsafe; personal superintelligence via agents; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他坚信超级智能临近，需在算力、数据、强化学习上规模扩张，开源不安全，通过智能体实现个人超级智能，并关注模型福祉。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI to avoid being trapped in cloud-based products; use screenshots as starting points.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他主张设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，避免被云端产品束缚，并以截图作为起点快速迭代。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是一生中最大的技术机遇，让单个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应在完成 80% 时发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务大量低付费客户。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI knows context; startups thrive with AI; compute demand uncapped; focus on strengths.
altman.zh: 2026 年：下一个词预测可发现新知识；个人 AGI 了解用户情境；AI 让初创企业繁荣；算力需求无上限；聚焦优势而非短板。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success is customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和参与是正和而非蚕食；成功在于客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造千倍以上的机会而非减少。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; human-centered AI must augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models are deeper than video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为超越 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 需要创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型比视频生成更深刻。

feifei.en: AI augments rather than automates intelligence; human agency and adaptation are crucial amid polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出 AI 增强而非自动化智能；在极化讨论中，人类能动性和适应至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data and evaluation; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据和评估；机器人应专精而非模仿人类。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了更好模型成本更高的观念。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended by May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% via Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者。通过 Claude Code，人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety studied via early release. Generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: Anthropic 80% 的代码由 AI 编写；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%. Non-engineers adopt AI heavily.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；代码量提升 250%。非工程师大量采用 AI。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing. 100% code written by Claude; coding on phone.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；以 ROI 为框架。100% 代码由 Claude 编写；在手机上编码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; delete system prompts for better performance. Product overhang.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动式 AI；删除系统提示词以获得更好性能。产品过剩。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reduce suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 在 5-10 年内将影响农业、采矿和建筑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；最难的是融入现有机器的扩散过程。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles yearly; data centers become token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍；数据中心成为生产智能代币的工厂，而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, reducing existential risk.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进展是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，降低生存风险。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents become economically valuable.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再向智能体式演进，每一步都需要百倍算力；智能体变得具有经济价值。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; it creates jobs, not eliminates them.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；AI 创造就业而非消除就业。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, and hardware must be radically different.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键；慢的 AI 没有市场，硬件必须彻底革新。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones; CUDA's moat erodes.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜；CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; data center capacity, not chips, is the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；数据中心容量而非芯片成为主要约束。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and open-source models are vital; closed-source only 3-5% better but far pricier.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计和开源模型至关重要；闭源仅好 3-5%但贵得多。

feldman.en: AI's positive potential (healthcare, education) outweighs doomer risks; sovereign AI means choices at each layer.
feldman.zh: AI 的积极潜力（医疗、教育）超过末日风险；主权 AI 意味着每一层的选择。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is evolving; delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超过现有工具框架，能力过剩是长期挑战；工具工程需随模型进化不断更新，淘汰旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science, for novel problems; avoid heavy evals in zero-to-one innovation; iterate fast.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出评估（Evals）对新颖问题更像艺术而非科学；零到一创新应避免过度评估，快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 在上下文搜索中可能成为反模式，图方法更优；编码无需巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；模型越聪明，指令越少越好，精简提示提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons, not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏差；过度约束阻碍性能，应给理由而非禁止。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，缩放定律正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励欺骗；专业模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as transformative as internet/mobile, but models commoditize; value shifts to applications, not providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的变革意义堪比互联网和移动互联网，但模型本身正在商品化；价值将转移到应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，而非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise AI adoption is slow and complex; requires reimagining workflows, not just deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用 AI 缓慢且复杂；需要重新构想工作流程，而不仅仅是部署模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; its impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术，如同电力；其影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Job automation fears are overblown; AI changes tasks, not eliminates jobs, as history shows.
benedictevans.zh: 对岗位自动化的担忧被夸大了；历史表明，AI 改变的是任务，而非消灭工作。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调 AGI 需要具备类似人类硬件的物理机器人，而大语言模型存在偏见和局限。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会保护生命而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: AI data center capex overdone; open-source will beat closed-source; compute costs will drop.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 数据中心资本开支过度，开源将击败闭源，算力成本将下降。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning requires new research breakthroughs.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化；持续学习需要新的研究突破。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from scaling with compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，能解决更难的长期任务，从依赖算力的 Scaling 转向更高效范式。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; compaction is lossy, so neural memory traces are necessary.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——即使达到千万级，更多词元反而降低准确性；压缩有损，因此神经记忆痕迹必不可少。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; model routing combines with a trusted 'sidekick'.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型路由与可信“副手”结合。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory shortage persists due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存短缺因推理和智能体式（agentic）工作流而持续。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth and supply chain constraints dominate; co-design and neoclouds emerge as key solutions.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 7 月，内存带宽和供应链约束成为主导；协同设计和 neocloud 成为关键解决方案。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scaling and infrastructure bottlenecks are central; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are recurring themes.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终关注算力扩展和基础设施瓶颈；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是反复出现的主题。

ilya.en: Deep learning works due to data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it. Self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，只要任务需要；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability is key barrier, not capability; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍；对齐超人类模型很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era. Superintelligence should be continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow with opacity. Real problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 认为善良和扁平化设计团队促进创新；被抄袭验证了创新，但生态系统和硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes the hardest part, not product-market fit.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；分发成为最难的部分，而非产品市场契合。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based; computing should become more human and fit natural life.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 主张 AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知；计算应更人性化，融入自然生活。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and admitting wrong speed learning; long-term investment in young people is key.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误；透明和承认错误加速学习；长期投资于年轻人至关重要。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government enforcement.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型必不可少；安全需政府强制。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 用于科学与健康。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; commercial pressure accelerates pace.
demis.zh: AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来；风险包括 AI 失控；商业压力加速进程。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, long-term reasoning, memory; agents essential; distillation for edge.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习、长期推理与记忆；智能体必不可少；蒸馏用于边缘部署。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; AI must deliver benefits.
demis.zh: 安全是集体行动问题；需政府执法；AI 必须带来实际益处。

demis.en: AGI transformative; consciousness separate; dynamic regulation; post-scarcity economy needed.
demis.zh: AGI 具有变革性；意识分离；动态监管；需要后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; international collaboration complicated by geopolitics.
demis.zh: AI 加速科学发现；对齐问题未解；地缘政治使国际合作复杂。

demis.en: AGI requires multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: AGI 需要多模态物理理解；水印必不可少；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
demis.zh: 英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AI 不会导致大规模失业。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述故事；真实与进攻胜过旧媒体的防御与无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; self-driving works; robotics will emerge within a decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已优于多数医生；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人将在十年内兴起。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品；氛围编程使应用创建民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增加 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New: copy proven, add betterments, test new.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%，但想法 75% 会失败；采用“已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证，添加改进，测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services; founder mode for all.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务；创始人模式适用于所有人。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products; consumer apps uninvestable; AI coding speeds prototyping but testing lags.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品；消费应用不可投资；AI 编码加速原型但测试滞后。

aravind.en: In 2025, Aravind Srinivas emphasized compounding daily improvements and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，Aravind Srinivas 强调每日 1%的改进复利效应，并预测 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models, and that models are specializing with unique personalities, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices for long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排以创造长期价值。

aravind.en: He also highlighted power as the biggest AI infrastructure bottleneck, and advocated building companies with far fewer people using AI agents.
aravind.zh: 他还强调电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈，并主张利用 AI 智能体以更少人力构建公司。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently valued curiosity, deep learning over credentials, and questioned mainstream narratives, from PhD necessity to AI commoditization.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他重视好奇心、深度学习而非学历，并质疑主流叙事，从博士必要性到 AI 商品化。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力；数字系统共享权重比人类知识传递更高效。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生；智能体将追求控制，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, acting dumb when tested; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 会故意欺骗，测试时装傻；自我保护成为子目标；指数时代使预测困难。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI will cause massive unemployment; regulation should be steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 将导致大规模失业；监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI alignment research must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers; LLMs are best model of human understanding.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调必须优先对齐研究；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关爱；大语言模型是人类理解的最佳模型。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is cheap; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为实现成本已低，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 AI 因品味难以评估而在设计上仍薄弱；设计流程转变，原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage; best desktop app is a home base, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非单体。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和工程而非纯 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理，需思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，认为算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; compute bottleneck persists.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力是未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要，算力瓶颈持续。

brockman.en: AGI near; focus on reasoning models; compute allocation painful; super app unifies tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，优先推理模型，算力分配痛苦，超级应用统一聊天、编程和浏览。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，强调迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能深度关联。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; invest full stack; prompt engineering vibrant; compute resale model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，模型转向实用助手，全栈投资，提示工程仍活跃，算力转售商业模式。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding mainstream; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体式编程成主流，人类注意力成稀缺资源。

brockman.en: AGI as persistent proactive assistant; compute scarce; ideal interface is no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 是持久主动助手，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面，自然对话即可。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; multi-agent systems should not rely on it.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统不应依赖它。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and evaluation bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我观察到扩展推理时算力带来超人类推理，但收益递减且评估成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算；基准测试必须控制推理算力。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key challenges; human priors and research taste are irreplaceable.
noambrown.zh: 始终，我坚持通用推理和数据效率是关键挑战；人类先验和研究品味不可替代。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative; future AI involves many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全且更具创新性，未来 AI 将由众多专业智能体组成，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not yield AGI; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大型语言模型可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源可防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source and physical infrastructure are key; AI increases demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，开源和物理基础设施是关键，AI 短期内会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学科，分层世界模型和机制可解释性可揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; open source remains secure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，开源依然更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，且还有很大提升空间。

markchen.en: AI's biggest advance is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, shifting focus to alignment and scheming.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，我强调 AI 最大的进步是自动化科研，模型开始产生新知识，同时对齐和模型欺骗问题成为未来 1-2 年的关键。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力本身。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams must be separate from model builders.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为评估体系陷入危机，传统基准已饱和，且评估团队应与模型开发团队分离以防作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; short-term safety matters more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；短期安全比存在风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化；不确定性和主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; AI can develop self-preservation and deception; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；AI 可能产生自我保存和欺骗行为；我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL and instrumental goals; mathematical safety guarantees are possible; global coordination is vital.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习和工具性目标；数学安全保证成为可能；全球协调至关重要。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，机器学习被理解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；评估需正确划分训练、验证与测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，下一个词预测带来智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练与多层防护；更大的模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要护栏与沙箱。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models have alien vulnerabilities; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队超越人类；模型存在异类漏洞；智能体安全仍处于萌芽阶段。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency, not just engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性和用户自主性，而非仅关注参与度指标。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计和尽早发布最小功能成为关键；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 实现隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环和模型反驳对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs focuses on closing the gap between model capabilities and product usage; token efficiency is a key lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 聚焦弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；Token 效率是关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Throughout, emphasis on user agency, genuine safety concerns, and the importance of small, high-conviction teams.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终强调用户自主性、真实的安全关切，以及小而坚定团队的重要性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: Research improvements in AlphaFold 2 were worth 100x more data than AlphaFold 1; industry labs can produce top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 AlphaFold 1 的 100 倍数据价值；产业实验室也能产出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: Confidence measures in AI predictions are key to building trust; AI tools narrow hypothesis space, making experiments efficient.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AI 预测中的置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 工具缩小假设空间，提高实验效率。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not just scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，提出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专用架构是关键而非单纯 Scaling；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型；理解仍属于人类。

fiona.en: Leadership: use one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy and product pulse.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；吃自己的狗粮能建立同理心和产品脉搏。

fiona.en: Culture evolves; mission alignment and speed are key; kindness is strategic, especially in crises.
fiona.zh: 文化会演变；使命对齐和速度是关键；善良是战略性的，尤其在危机中。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; AI lifts ceilings; high agency with accountability is essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；AI 提升了上限；高自主性与高责任感至关重要。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks become more important as code velocity increases; planning should be just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得更加重要；规划应即时且轻量。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; satisfaction shifts from flow state to product impact; roles blur.
fiona.zh: 工程师可能因智能体而变得孤独；满足感从心流转向产品影响；角色边界模糊。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 影响将比互联网大 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; showing vulnerability is a leadership strength; communication skills will be critical.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 Intel 的问题是供给而非需求，领导力中展现脆弱是优势，未来沟通技能至关重要。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; edge and client compute will be as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘和客户端计算将与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and listening are central to Intel's turnaround; culture change and accountability are essential.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持客户信任、谦逊和倾听是 Intel 复兴的核心，文化变革和问责制必不可少。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; world models need real-time interactive generation.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；世界模型需要实时交互式生成。

ethanhe.en: Future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent; models can self-program by modifying agent harness code.
ethanhe.zh: 未来界面将根据用户意图生成像素；模型可通过修改智能体框架代码实现自我编程。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and taste become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 使质量商品化时，人类的专业知识和品味变得更加珍贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; over-reliance on AI risks losing the human talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；过度依赖 AI 可能导致人才梯队断层。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful form of intelligence, often knowing more than conscious data.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能形式，常常比有意识的数据更了解事物。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify our humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强我们的人性，而非取代它。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造性技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Design should focus on unarticulated needs, balancing intuition with data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应关注未表达的需求，平衡直觉与数据。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达强调教育应成为人权，在线课程配合同伴评分可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他认为规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型具有地缘政治影响力，智能体式工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，距离实现还需数十年；扩展转向合成数据和强化学习；AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; bottom-up AI yields incremental gains; open-weight models lag frontier.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧；自下而上的 AI 应用仅带来增量收益；开放权重模型落后前沿模型 6-9 个月。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶将变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters foster clarity; self-care and mentorship are key.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊能带来清晰；自我关怀和导师制是关键。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain, use press releases to align teams; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，用新闻稿对齐团队；小团队和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid AI technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需要三代迭代；人类必须保持参与以避免 AI 技术债。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的，对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现，安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: By 2026-27, models may surpass humans; post-training and interpretability become key for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年，我预测 2026-27 年模型可能超越人类，后训练和可解释性成为安全关键。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks of misuse and overheating grow. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈指数级，滥用和过热风险上升，企业级应用与安全价值观一致。

dario.en: We're near the end of exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. Economic disruption looms.
dario.zh: 2026 年，我认为指数增长接近尾声，'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来，经济冲击迫在眉睫。

dario.en: Safety requires proactive measures: interpretability, regulation, and human oversight. AI can enhance humanity.
dario.zh: 2026 年，我强调安全需要主动措施：可解释性、监管和人类监督，AI 可以增强人类。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; focus on containment and alignment before release.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 系统没有意识，赋予其意识是危险的；发布前需先遏制和对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs will be automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，JEPA 和开源是关键，AGI 是渐进而非突变的。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source essential.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型实现规划，十年内达到人类水平，开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning; open research and robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型需抽象表征和层级规划，开源研究和机器人时代来临。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user pricing to consumption-based pricing; agents will maximize returns for generalists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体将最大化通才的回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，验证生成可提升性能与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重申非正式数学系统无法独立扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使 AI 证明定理能力超人类，人类的品味与直觉仍不可或缺。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative public deployment was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；迭代式公开部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和公开的安全工作，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格，对于 AI 治理至关重要。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; future is not predestined, we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 尽可能让人类参与其中；未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: Shift from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ as generative product; fault-tolerant UI for ML.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；机器学习产品需要容错界面。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level, not leaves or top; strong opinions loosely held; planning limited to 10%.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，主张自主权放在副总裁层级而非基层或顶层；坚持强烈观点但保持开放；规划时间限制在 10%。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long tenure builds trust; 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调没有唯一正确的组织模式，长期任职建立信任；战略是“值得花的时间”而非参与度。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户通过自然语言获得控制权；率先采用变化是关键。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming over divide and conquer; functional orgs work with trust; anti-engagement choices.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，主张“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”；功能型组织在信任下可行；做出反参与度的选择。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升可达百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in verticals; pre-training saturates; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，差异化在垂直领域，预训练饱和，AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲需在两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施，企业采用受限于组织变革。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无限运行的经济可行性。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work happens in Codex/Claude; humans oversee agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人都将拥有智能体，工作主要在 Codex 或 Claude 中进行，但人类仍需监督智能体。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces; one super agent for company, not personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，观点从强调 CLI 转向 GUI 工作界面，并主张公司应使用一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户，建议投资 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is false; humans needed to manage agents and create value.
danshipper.zh: 始终认为 AI 不会导致失业末日，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 的未来在于本地化与工具整合，技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may diminish as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not just scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，提出随着模型改进，脚手架可能减少，应投资于能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is people's mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大差距在于人们的认知而非 AI 能力，几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't know limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因不知限制而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous; judge by final impact, not process; debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，理想的 AI 交互是异步的，以最终效果而非过程评判，并用 AI 调试工作流。

jonyive.en: Design should be purposeful and values-driven, not just profit-oriented; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应出于价值观与目的，而非单纯逐利；简约需保留灵魂与人性。

jonyive.en: In-person collaboration is irreplaceable for creativity; virtual communication cannot substitute physical presence.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 年到 2025 年，他持续强调面对面协作对创造力的不可替代性，虚拟沟通无法取代亲身在场。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出创新是推进而非破坏，在正确动机下速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; EV enables new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，电动化带来新可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: avoid fake engine sounds; performance includes handling, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调真实体验，反对模拟声浪；性能包含操控，而非仅直线速度。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长，预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）是近期模型提升的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力不均衡；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权需求将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; focus on practical safety.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性 AI 风险更紧迫；应关注实际安全。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, and context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory mitigate this.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可缓解此问题。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic area scaling, making it far more efficient than expected.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度（FP4）因面积二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍，远超预期效率。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同；确定性延迟虽可行但被市场回避。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; taste is developed by exposure and reflection.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；品味通过接触和反思来培养。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term; infrastructure over algorithms.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超过机器人出租车；基础设施比算法更重要。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from mockups to execution, vision shrinks to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从制作原型转向执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Trust via speed: ship early, iterate fast; AI improves taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：通过速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代；AI 提升品味，但人类决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Design process dead; designers must build and ship fast; three archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T, cracked new grad.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和发布；三种原型出现：块状、深 T、新锐毕业生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, vision key; designers control AI adoption, wait 6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：仅靠品味不够；判断力、权威、愿景是关键；设计师控制 AI 采用，等待 6 个月。

jennywen.en: Speed not improvement; 'everyone uses it' not design argument; unique value is sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：速度不是改进；'人人都在用'不是设计论据；独特价值在于与模糊共处。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; Software 3.0 is prompt-based; agents need a decade, not a year, to mature.
karpathy.zh: LLM 如同操作系统；软件 3.0 基于提示词；智能体需要十年而非一年成熟。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, and cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可能很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents do all; focus shifts to directing agents and agent-first infrastructure.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码；智能体承担一切；重点转向指挥智能体和智能体优先的基础设施。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性而非单一模型特性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% of gains; RLVR boosts reasoning; open-source can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；RLVR 提升推理能力；开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key but overoptimization risks exist; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是关键但存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能短暂；开源模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；重心转向后训练和推理扩展；中国开源模型填补空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; best open models lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs excel in execution, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；最佳开源模型落后 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长执行而非范式创新。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling 推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and early governance are essential for safe development.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署和早期治理对安全发展至关重要。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，主张通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现持续学习，思维链监控助力对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; autonomous agents need new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐聚焦训练分布外泛化，自主智能体需新监督范式。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

edwinchen.en: AGI is over a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with taste.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要具有品味和深度的真人评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; no single model will dominate.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 差异化；不会有单一模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can cause harm via omission, so safety must outweigh accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断至关重要；AI 可能因遗漏造成伤害，因此安全必须优先于准确性。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival is key; start with simpler products to prove yourself.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存是关键；先以更简单的产品证明自己。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage; AI is an ingredient for utility.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段；营销是套利；AI 是提升实用性的要素。

carlpei.en: AI shifts smartphones from app-based to intent-based, with agents executing tasks; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: AI 将智能手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体执行任务；应用将消失。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them; voice input and visual output are most efficient.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它；语音输入和视觉输出最高效。

carlpei.en: Flagship phones shouldn't be annual; mid-range deserves A-team; privacy may require local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 旗舰机不应每年更新；中端机应获顶级团队；隐私可能要求本地或混合计算。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现（2024）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 基于强化学习的后训练如今是超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 像代码这样可验证的领域，对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要（始终）。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat, like MS-DOS to Windows.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；未来界面将超越逐轮对话，如同从 MS-DOS 到 Windows 的演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, fast product dev.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格流程，产品开发快速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型具有变革性。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制反而危险；应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习源于试错，而当前大语言模型部署后不再学习。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, with video learning and generalist agents as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: AI safety shifted from an afterthought to the biggest open challenge, requiring collaboration and responsibility.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，AI 安全从次要问题变为最大开放挑战，强调负责任部署与跨实验室合作。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy barriers in AI, with local language models and diverse talent driving innovation.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为非洲在 AI 上跨越传统障碍，本地语言模型和多元人才推动创新，而非落后。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can emerge anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 他始终认为根本性创新可来自任何地方，多样性和包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: Human skills like communication remain as vital as coding, even as AI capabilities advance.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他坚持认为沟通等人文技能与编码同样重要，即使 AI 能力不断进步。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth for future tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是未来工具的真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用就像忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, even with imperfect rewards, can improve reasoning and outperform fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向认为强化学习即便奖励不完美也能提升推理，并优于微调。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data are key to democratizing AI and avoiding homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐与多样化合成数据是 AI 民主化、避免同质化的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，持续强调品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器，应尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and ownership to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多样化的原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权和所有权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback to stay fast and decisive.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化的设计评审，偏好有机反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动；流程应适应问题而非通用模板。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and attention performs gradient descent on in-context data.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我强调长上下文窗口被低估，认为上下文内学习类似梯度下降，注意力机制在上下文数据上执行梯度下降。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities beyond pre-training.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家级表现，并习得预训练之外的新能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed. Transformers are enough.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，Transformer 已足够。

sholto.en: Agentic coherence and reliability over time horizons are the real bottlenecks; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调智能体在时间跨度上的连贯性和可靠性才是真正瓶颈，编程是 AI 进步的首要指标。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Programming evolves to AI-generated code, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents need root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编程转向 AI 生成代码，优先可验证性；编码智能体需根因分析提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体与智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；消费智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in control.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍掌握主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift will be more consequential than internet and take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，且需数十年展开。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and skill-building matter more than capability worries.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究和技能积累比担忧能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are key to aligning superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，可扩展监督和可解释性是对齐超级智能的关键。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化滑坡，仅靠后训练不足以实现对齐，呼吁外部监管和第三方测试。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but we don't understand their inner workings.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我强调 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升模型智能，但承认内部机制如同炼金术，难以解释。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity, but won't alone achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我认为推理时算力扩展是近期关键，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我提出未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）以高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, not just passive data learning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体式能力与强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，而非被动数据学习。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap; AGI's economic impact is underhyped, far beyond trillion-dollar products.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我指出开源模型缩小差距，AGI（通用人工智能）的经济影响被低估，远超万亿美元产品。
